3. None appears on behalf of the respondent￾Uttarakhand Pharmacy Council as the matter is 
being taken up on mention.
4. Learned counsel for the petitioner submits 
that the controversy involved in the present writ 
petition is squarely covered by the judgment 
and order passed by this Court in WPMS No.

Council, State of Uttarakhand & Others, dated 
12.02.2026, as, in the case of Pratibha Rawat, 
petitioner had failed in Chemistry in 
Intermediate, whereas the present petitioner 
has failed in Biology.
